title: Soldier with an M16 — possibly PFC Stanton
description: A young soldier in eyeglasses grins in the doorway of a green board-and-batten building, an M16-family rifle across his chest. Larry does not know who this is; the one name he offered as a guess is PFC Stanton.
larrysRecollection: My father does not know who this is. A guess name he said is PFC Stanton
researchNotes: Relayed by Larry's son from Larry's dictation (2026-08-15 session; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0026-c18035534.json). Explicitly a guess — the weakest identification in the batch; the person record carries the same caveat. It also settles the survey's open question: the resemblance to Larry notwithstanding, this is not Larry with glasses on.
